description: Puts your own image behind every BB conversation as a soft haze that fades out before the text. Pick one of six effects (None, Dither, ASCII, Halftone, Scanlines, Haze) and set a separate background for each project. Window glass can blur the same image behind the whole window, with a see-through sidebar and main pane. Images stay in your BB server's local database; no account is needed. Turn off Aura while Haze is on.
